description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter_DeviceAtlas, which implements the Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter interface. It provides functionality to extract device features from an HTTP request using the DeviceAtlas API, including handling configuration and loading necessary classes.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter_DeviceAtlas
classes.description: An adapter class that integrates with the DeviceAtlas API to retrieve device features based on the HTTP request data.

methods.name: getFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves device features from the request headers using the DeviceAtlas API, handling configuration and class dependencies.
